interface.no_network: no provider call, dependency install, model inference, Docker command, deployment or test execution

secrets.entropy: independent secrets.token_urlsafe(48) values; no fixed development secret or fake API key
secrets.hosted_key: optional explicit existing environment variable only; never command argument value, terminal prompt, stdout, instruction file or Compose override
secrets.permissions: 0600 complete private temporary files; atomic exclusive hard-link installation refuses existing destination, symlink/nonregular paths denied, intentional --force uses checked atomic replacement
secrets.stdout: only provider, presence flags, non-secret file paths and public endpoints
secrets.build_context: env/output/temp names use .env or .env.* so existing Git and Docker ignore rules exclude private bytes even after abrupt interruption

compose_alignment.mongodb: authenticated mongo service URIs with authSource=admin; generated root initialization credentials match current Compose bootstrap
compose_alignment.engine: SKELETON_INTERNAL_URL=http://skeleton:8001 shared with a sealed engine token/principal; allowlisted chat capabilities and explicit tenant IDs
compose_alignment.frontend: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SKELETON_URL use operator-selected host-reachable addresses and actual host ports
compose_alignment.backend_auth: generated override passes GAMEFORGE_AUTH_ENFORCE=1 and GAMEFORGE_JWT_SECRET to actual canonical auth owner; existing legacy JWT_SECRET retained
compose_alignment.local_artifact: existing bounded regular host artifact mounted read-only into the skeleton container at /app/data/local-model.json via generated Compose override; no fabricated weights or copying into an unknown Docker volume
compose_alignment.local_artifact_permissions: existing image UID10001 must have private read access; generated Linux instructions show an explicit per-user ACL grant without changing artifact permissions automatically

readiness: presence only; artifact format, provider access, image builds and actual service readiness remain unverified until the operator starts the stack and inspects the authenticated catalog
failure: partial private output creation rolls back newly created files
validation: source review and formatting only; no tests requested or run in this wave
scope_limitations: file replacement does not rotate existing MongoDB users or destroy persistent volumes
no provider/model readiness or quality claim
